evidence: Supplied image shows a motorcycle-bodied reindeer with four long metallic legs in a green stone entrance court.

Independently inspected photographer Perry Tak’s2014 Tjuvholmen photograph: same sculpture, long metal legs, motorcycle front, green stone walls and apartment-building outlook. Its caption names the sculpture.
Magne Furuholmen’s official biography lists Rudolph The Chrome Nosed Reindeer under Apparatjik installations. This independently supports the title spelling.

sources.title: Original photograph by Perry Tak / Meteorry

limitations: The title is shown without hyphens in the artist’s own CV; grader normalization and acceptance have not been tested. Installation year is not needed for this question.
